image_description: The image displays three distinct wall-mounted objects arranged horizontally against a textured, aged beige wall. Each object is a surreal hybrid combining an antique wooden clock case with an electric guitar. The left object features a rectangular grandfather-style clock case with the neck and sunburst semi-hollow body of a guitar extending downwards from it. The center object has a tall, ornate clock case with a teal Stratocaster-style solid-body guitar emerging from its lower section. The right object shows a clock face integrated into the upper part of a dark blue/black semi-hollow guitar body, with the guitar's headstock visible above the clock mechanism. All three guitars have complete necks, fretboards, bodies, pickups, bridges, and headstocks with tuning pegs.
